questions.prompt: Which principle is most useful when applying Advanced Browser Compatibility?
options: professional styling needs intentional architecture, repeatable checks and clear trade-offs
It removes the need to understand HTML semantics, the CSS cascade or browser behavior.
It makes every interface responsive and accessible without testing.
It runs all utility classes as JavaScript in the browser.
questions.answer_key: professional styling needs intentional architecture, repeatable checks and clear trade-offs
questions.explanation: Advanced Browser Compatibility is best understood through the syllabus topics: Reviewing v4's browser requirements, Testing CSS features in supported browsers, Evaluating legacy browser needs. Choose the technique deliberately and verify the result.

questions.prompt: Which workflow is strongest when working with advanced browser compatibility?
options: Add classes until a screenshot looks acceptable without inspecting generated CSS.
Assume that starting a development server proves every page and state works.
Skip narrow-screen testing because utility-first CSS is automatically responsive.
make a minimal reproduction, document decisions and test representative combinations
questions.answer_key: make a minimal reproduction, document decisions and test representative combinations
questions.explanation: A reliable workflow checks generated CSS and the actual interface. Related topics include: Reviewing v4's browser requirements, Testing CSS features in supported browsers, Evaluating legacy browser needs, Understanding progressive enhancement.

questions.prompt: Which common mistake should you avoid when applying advanced browser compatibility?
options: Use the official documentation for version-specific behavior.
Check keyboard states where controls are involved.
a local example does not prove shared-theme or monorepo integration is complete
Document intended behavior and test representative content.
questions.answer_key: a local example does not prove shared-theme or monorepo integration is complete
questions.explanation: Good styling work is verified, version-aware and tested with realistic content and input methods.
